text: The compose task checks the default icon and two active setIcon updates. The new wait only requires listStyleImage to differ from none; it does not wait for the requested expected path, so a previous non-none icon can satisfy the wait. The subsequent equality assertion still checks the exact image-set. Keep that condition limit separate from an observed intermittent failure or a claimed cure; no test was run.
title: The compose icon wait checks readiness before an exact path assertion
